title: Knuth sees something fall into the sea through night-vision goggles

tellings.quote: but I actually saw something fall and hit the water in infrared.

plain: In 2021, off Laguna Beach in California, a scientist named Kevin Knuth says he watched something fall out of the sky and hit the sea, which he saw through night-vision goggles that show heat. Knuth tells Michels this himself as a witness: "I actually saw something fall and hit the water in infrared." If he is right, an unexplained object came down into the ocean in front of him.
